rules.sentence: Typically, symptoms of fatigue, body aches, and anorexia improve within 24 hours of treatment.
Additional symptoms such as bruising, gingival bleeding, perifollicular hemorrhage, and weakness tend to respond within 1 to 2 weeks following treatment initiation.
Corkscrew hairs usually return to their normal appearance within 1 month, and most symptoms tend to resolve completely within 3 months.[9]
Surgical intervention might be necessary to manage severe and advanced bone abnormalities.
Bone pain and limp: Osteomyelitis and septic arthritis.
